messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-827312 — High queue backlog observed in inference-cell us-west-2-a (queue: inference-requests). Routing: primary -> us-west-2-a.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: page triggered (PD-827312). Escalation level: 1.

oncall-rotation: ack @pagerduty @incident-bot — taking initial triage.

taylor: ack. seeing queue length spike on dashboard. heatmap shows steady incoming: ~680 req/sec, processing capacity dropping.

jamal: current queue depth: 74,900 items (prom: inference_queue_depth{cell="us-west-2-a"}=74900). avg processing latency bumped from 300ms -> 2.1s. error rate still ~0.2% but tail latency causing pileup.

nina: autoscaler metrics: scale_controller.pending_pods > 0 and provision rate stalled. Kube API errors: "quota exceeded" for nodepool-spare-usw2.

devops-liaison: copying logs from scale-controller: ```time="2026-01-18T20:12:10Z" level=warn msg="failed to request nodes: quotaExceeded" controller=scale-controller cell=us-west-2-a```

jamal: looks like autoscaler not getting nodes fast enough — provisioning delay ~6m, backlog growing. manual mitigations: we can either spin up nodes in on-demand pool or reroute low-priority traffic to backup region.

taylor: customer-impact check: CS dashboards show elevated latencies for a small subset of customers on enterprise tier; support queue has 3 pings in last 10m. no widespread 5xx yet.

oncall-rotation: plan: 1) acknowledge PD (done), 2) attempt manual node spin-up in spare pool, 3) apply routing fallback to global low-latency fallback with degraded model variant for non-critical requests, 4) handoff to infra after mitigation.

jamal: manual node spin-up: `gcloud compute instances create --count=4 --machine-type=n1-standard-8 --zone=us-west2-a --labels=purpose=redwood-inference-temp` — starting now.

nina: started, but hitting org quota limit for CPUs. request for quota bump submitted to cloud console; estimated approval time unknown.

devops-liaison: quick alternative: scale up dedicated spare pool in us-west-2-b (already approved). spinning up 6 nodes there and will add cross-region routing. initiating now.

incident-bot: action logged: manual_spinup initiated by devops-liaison at 2026-01-18T20:15:46Z.

taylor: implementing routing change: update service route table to send low-priority traffic to us-west-2-b and to degrade slot-based batching for non-enterprise tenants. applying in 1 minute.

jamal: putting temporary admission control: reject new long-context requests for 30s to drain backlog (will return 429). Config snippet: ```service.admission.reject_long_context=true; window=30s```

customer-success: notified enterprise SREs for impacted accounts; proactive message template prepared.

oncall-rotation: handoff note: if manual spinup completes and queue returns to <5k within 20m, we will resolve PD and file postmortem. if queue still >20k after 30m, escalate to paging level 2 and involve capacity-ops.

jamal: update: cross-region nodes are joining cluster, kube nodes ready=4/6, pod autoscaler now scheduling additional replicas. queue depth dropping to 29,800.

taylor: latency 95p back to ~600ms. customer pings falling.

pagerduty: PD-827312 acknowledged by oncall-rotation at 2026-01-18T20:18:03Z.

incident-bot: PD-827312 updated: status=acknowledged, mitigation=in-flight, sla-impact=partial (elevated latency for subset).

devops-liaison: leaving a note for next shift: quota gating on on-demand pool blocked direct spinup; cross-region fallback used. follow-up: request CPU quota increase for us-west2 project and revisit autoscaler logic to prefer spare-pool when quota is low.

oncall-rotation: last update before handoff: backlog reduced to 6,400 at 2026-01-18T20:27:40Z. continuing to monitor for 20m. handoff to night-oncall in 10m.

customer-success: sent status update to affected customers: short blip with elevated latencies, mitigation applied, follow-up postmortem promised.

oncall-rotation: closing notes will be added to PD ticket and incident doc if stable. escalating to level2 only if we see re-rise. :white_check_mark:
